scripts.text:
[Noa]
Hello~
Welcome to ^8B4513Ayothaya^000000.
This town is linked to a river through the wild forest.
It's a really calm country.
Take your time to look around.
scripts.translation:
[諾亞]
您好~
歡迎來到^8B4513哎喲泰雅^000000。
穿過茂密的森林，就有一條河流與這座城鎮相連。
這裡十分寧靜，請慢慢遊覽吧。

scripts.text:
[Noa]
The <NAVI>[Weapon Shop]<INFO>ayothaya,163,90,0,000,0</INFO></NAVI>
in Ayothaya has special weapons.
You can find great weapons there.
Is there anything else I can do for you?
scripts.translation:
[諾亞]
哎喲泰雅的<NAVI>[武器店]<INFO>ayothaya,163,90,0,000,0</INFO></NAVI>有獨特的武器，您一定能在那裡找到好武器。
還有什麼需要幫忙的嗎？

[Noa]
Part of adventuring is collecting information.
The <NAVI>[Tavern]<INFO>ayothaya,229,72,0,000,0</INFO></NAVI> is crowded with lots of travelers where you can get useful information.
Is there anything else I can do for you?
scripts.translation:
[諾亞]
收集情報也是冒險的一部分。<NAVI>[酒館]<INFO>ayothaya,229,72,0,000,0</INFO></NAVI>裡有很多旅行者，您可以在那裡打聽到有用的情報。
還有什麼需要幫忙的嗎？

scripts.text:
[Noa]
Ayothaya is close to the beach, so most people enjoy fishing.
They really love to fish.
Go <NAVI>[fishing]<INFO>ayothaya,255,99,0,000,0</INFO></NAVI> and try to grab a big fish.
Is there anything else I can do for you?
scripts.translation:
[諾亞]
哎喲泰雅靠海，居民們大多愛釣魚，而且特別痴迷。去<NAVI>[釣魚點]<INFO>ayothaya,255,99,0,000,0</INFO></NAVI>試試釣條大魚吧。
還有什麼需要幫忙的嗎？
